brief:
An Israeli journalist has warned that Palestinians face a significant threat of expulsion spanning from the Jordan River to the Mediterranean Sea, according to Middle East Eye. Amira Hass cautioned that Israel possesses both the political and military infrastructure necessary to drive Palestinians from their homeland, raising alarm about the long-term trajectory of Israeli policy.

The warning reflects deepening concerns among some Israeli observers about the direction of Israeli actions toward Palestinians in the occupied West Bank and Gaza Strip. Hass's assessment comes amid escalating tensions and recurring cycles of violence across the region, with growing debate within Israel over settlement expansion and Palestinian displacement.

title: Israeli journalist warns of Palestinian expulsion threat across occupied territories
